On instagram.com, open Create (+) → Live video and copy the “Stream key”. Instagram gives a new key for every broadcast.
In TikTok LIVE Center, open the stream key screen and copy the Server URL and the Stream key. Your account needs RTMP access; TikTok gives a new key for every broadcast.
In YouTube Studio, open Create → Go live → Streaming software and copy the “Stream key”. The key stays the same until you reset it.
On facebook.com, open Live video → Streaming software and copy the “Stream key”. Unless you turned on a persistent key, Facebook gives a new one for every broadcast.
In the Twitch Creator Dashboard, open Settings → Stream and copy your primary stream key.
On Kick, open Creator Dashboard → Settings → Stream URL & Key and copy the key. If it shows a different Stream URL, replace the server address with it.
Paste the RTMP or RTMPS address and the stream key your server gives you.
Now press “Go live” in Instagram; the stream becomes public only after that.

End the stream and open the receiver again. If the problem continues, try restarting the phone.
The upload is too slow; the stream goes on but some frames are skipped. Move to a stronger connection, use fewer platforms or lower the stream quality in DJI Fly.
The broadcast is kept open; it picks up where it left off when the controller reconnects.
The controller and the phone must be on the same Wi-Fi, or the controller must be connected to this phone\'s hotspot.
Type the address exactly; it must end with :1935/drone.
